teams.headline: Dodgers Edge Nats 6-3 Behind Ohtani XBH and Muncy HR

latest_news.title: Dodgers Edge Nats 6-3 Behind Ohtani XBH and Muncy HR
latest_news.summary: Los Angeles won their series finale behind a timely 3-run homer from Max Muncy and multi-hit performance from Shohei Ohtani.

latest_news.title: Freeman Returns from IL, Muncy Hits 30th Homerun
latest_news.summary: Freeman's first game back after the 60-day IL was a 3-for-4 performance. Muncy's 30th home run extended the Dodgers' NLEast lead to 7 games.

latest_news.title: Blake Treinen Named Closer After Diaz Option
latest_news.summary: Following Edwin Diaz's struggles, Dave Roberts announced Blake Treinen will handle the ninth inning.

latest_news.title: Gavin Stone Claims First NL September Win
latest_news.summary: Stone's 5-2 record improves to 3-0 in his last three September starts.

latest_news.title: Teoscar Hernandez Returns from Paternity Leave
latest_news.summary: Hernandez rejoins the lineup, adding depth to an already potent Dodgers lineup.

latest_news.title: Dodgers Place Young LHP on Paternity List
latest_news.summary: Left-hander Luke Weaver will miss the next 2 games to be with his wife for the birth of their first child.

fun_facts: Max Muncy hit his 30th homer of the season on September 5th
Shohei Ohtani's OPS of .923 is his highest since 2021 with the Angels
Dodgers pitchers have a collective 3.59 ERA in September, ranking in the top 5 NL

further_reading.title: Dodgers' Bullpen Transition: Who's Next After Diaz?
Ohtani's September Performance Projection
further_reading.summary: Advanced metrics project 40 HRs and 130 RBIs.

teams.one_sentence: The Dodgers (74-51) won 6-3 against the Nationals behind Freeman's return, Ohtani's multi-hits, and Muncy's 30th homer, as they look to close out September with a strong finish.

teams.headline: USC Dominates San Jose State 38-3 Behind Freshman QB's Debut

latest_news.title: USC Dominates San Jose State 38-3 Behind Freshman QB's Debut
latest_news.summary: Jayden Maiava threw for 286 yards and 3 touchdowns in his first start, leading USC to a dominant 38-3 victory.

latest_news.title: USC Ranks No. 14 in AP Poll Ahead of Season Opener
latest_news.summary: The Trojans entered the 2026 season ranked 14th in the AP Preseason Poll.

latest_news.title: USC Signs No. 1 Recruiting Class, Faces Depth Chart Questions
latest_news.summary: The Class of 2026 includes five 5-star recruits. Depth at OL remains a concern.

latest_news.title: Maiava's Debut: 286 Yards, 3 TDs, No Turnovers
latest_news.summary: The freshman quarterback completed 21-of-32 passes for 286 yards.

latest_news.title: USC Defense Holds SJSU to 93 Rushing Yards
latest_news.summary: The Trojans forced three turnovers and limited San Jose State to just 93 rushing yards.

latest_news.title: Five Trojans Earn All-Conference Honors in Preseason
latest_news.summary: WR Damien Washington, RB Isaiah McGuire, OT Malik Williams named to First Team All-Big Ten.

fun_facts: USC's 38-3 win marked their largest margin of victory since 2013
Jayden Maiava joined Teddy Bridgewater as the only QBs with 250+ yards in a debut start

further_reading.summary: Analysis of RBs, WRs, and OL rotation.

further_reading.title: Lincoln Riley's 2026 Game Plan: Pass, Run, Success

teams.one_sentence: USC's 38-3 domination of San Jose State behind QB Jayden Maiava's 286-yard debut and a stifling defense sent a message to the College Football Playoff committee as the Trojans chase their first-ever playoff berth.

teams.headline: Rams Fly to Australia for Historic Season Opener Against 49ers

latest_news.title: Rams Fly to Australia for Historic Season Opener Against 49ers
latest_news.summary: The Los Angeles Rams arrived in Melbourne for their September 11 season opener. The NFL's first regular season game Down Under.

latest_news.title: McVay: Entire Rams Roster Traveling to Melbourne, Including Donald
latest_news.summary: Head coach Sean McVay confirmed all 53 players will travel to Australia. Donald's participation remains TBD.

latest_news.title: Aaron Donald Completes Second Rams Workout Before Decision
latest_news.summary: President Donald underwent his second official practice session with the Rams on Sunday.

latest_news.title: Rams' Travel Strategy: Arriving 24 Hours Before Kickoff
latest_news.summary: McVay revealed the Rams will fly into Melbourne less than 24 hours before kickoff, using West Coast time to avoid jet lag.

latest_news.title: Ty Simpson Makes Final Push for QB2 Role
latest_news.summary: Simpson's preseason performance put him in position to unseat Stetson Bennett.

latest_news.title: Myles Garrett's Arrival 'Monster Energy' for Rams Defense
latest_news.summary: Garrett's presence has transformed the Rams' defensive culture.

fun_facts: The Rams are the only NFL team with a preseason win on the road this year
Matthew Stafford has completed 85% of his passes in the red zone this preseason

further_reading.title: Aaron Donald's Potential Impact in Australia
further_reading.summary: With Donald's potential return, the Rams could build momentum for 2026.

further_reading.title: Rams Training Camp Roster Battles Heat Up
further_reading.summary: With 53 roster spots to fill, the Rams have cuts every day.

teams.one_sentence: The Rams embark on a historic journey for their September 11 opener against the 49ers in Melbourne's MCG, with the entire roster traveling and Aaron Donald's potential return adding extra intrigue.
